verdict.rationale: The evidence documents App Lock and password export only as user-controlled settings. Admin control appears only in adjacent forms: administrators can allow or disallow notifications for work accounts, and organizations can mandate Authenticator push as the sign-in method. Nothing shows an admin enforcing app lock, restricting export, or mandating strong credentials across members' apps.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
